engineeringExperience.title: Distributed Real-time Processing System
engineeringExperience.description: Built a high-performance event processing system handling streaming data at scale. This system became the foundation for multiple product features and processing pipelines.
engineeringExperience.problem: Needed to process and react to user events in real-time at scale without significant latency
engineeringExperience.approach: Designed event-driven architecture with distributed workers, message queue, and state management
engineeringExperience.architecture: Event sourcing → Kafka → Stream processors → State store → API
engineeringExperience.impact: Reduced event processing latency from 30s to <100ms. Enabled 5 new product features.

engineeringExperience.impact: Improved query performance by 60%, reduced database costs by 40%
